description: List the times a service can be booked between from and to (at most 62 days), as visitors see them: inside opening hours and booking rules, minus existing bookings and busy times on linked Google Calendars. Each slot names a staff member. Pass a slot's startsAt and staffId to replo_bookings_create. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

addOnKeys.description: Add-ons the visitor wants; they make each booking longer, so fewer times fit

from.description: Start of the window to search

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects

seats.description: People in the party; 1 if left out

staffId.description: Only this staff member's times; anyone's if left out

to.description: End of the window to search; at most 62 days after from

name: replo_booking_slots_list
title: List open booking times
